messages:
maya: kicking off a small canary for the console beta feature. plan: enable flag `console.ui.hiddenSettings` for ~10% of active users in us-west-2 and a handful of partner orgs (see list below). timeframe: start now, observe for 24h, then decide forward/back.

maya: rollout targets: 10% traffic, orgs: org-1042, org-2107, org-3311, org-4450, org-9921. will use featureflag-service with rollout id 98765.

maya: pinging @ashwin for oncall coverage and perf guardrails, and @lina for UX QA/tooltip copy verification. @sam can you queue a quick CR check for the server side check? :eyes:

ashwin: got it. checklist:
- add metric: console.hiddenSettings.shown (count)
- add error rate and latency alarms for the console routes (thresholds: 5% error rate sustained 5m, 150ms p50 delta)
- validate KV cache hit behavior so we don't regress tail latency
- ensure rate-limiter still applies to canary users

ashwin: if any alarm fires, kill the rollout and rollback the flag. prefer manual rollback for first 24h.

lina: UX notes: UI change is minimal — an extra row in Settings -> Advanced. copy suggestion: `Try our new hidden settings (beta) — advanced controls for power users.` tooltip: `Beta: may change. Provide feedback via Help > Send Feedback.`

lina: small request: show a subtle beta badge and make the row collapsible. QA path: log in as canary org user, visit /settings/advanced, expect the row to be visible.

maya: sample toggle command for ops (featureflag-service API):
```
# enable rollout id 98765 to 10% in us-west-2
curl -X POST https://ff-service.internal/api/v1/rollouts/98765/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"us-west-2","percent":10}'
```

maya: test query to verify exposure metric:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_TOKEN" "https://metrics.internal/api/count?metric=console.hiddenSettings.shown&since=1h"
```

sam: CR done for server-side checks, added a kill-switch env var `CONSOLE_HIDDEN_KILL` and a shortcut in the admin console (internal-only) to flip it. pushed to staging, request quick sanity before canary.

sam: also uploaded the canary org list as a feature-audience in ff-service (audience id: fa-2026-04).

maya: deploy-bot scheduled flag update:
deploy-bot: FeatureFlagUpdate(98765) scheduled by maya at 1823154321: target=us-west-2 percent=10 audiences=[org-1042,org-2107,org-3311,org-4450,org-9921] rollout_mode=percent

maya: running the rollout now. I'll watch metrics and leave a running log in #incidents if anything looks off. link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/r/runbooks/console-beta-rollout

ashwin: oncall ack, I will monitor infra alerts and tracer dashboards. ping me with times if you want synchronous handoff.

lina: QA will run a smoke pass in ~30m, will report back.

maya: thanks all. if no regressions in 24h we can widen to 50% and schedule comms for a broader beta. :thumbsup:
